meta.layout: Coefficient matrices are k x n (rows: const, then lag 1 block in variable order, ..., lag p block; columns: equations), y_t = B'x_t + u_t. Matrices are row-major nested lists.

description: (b) Conjugate NIW posterior at fixed hyperparameters: Sigma | Y ~ IW(scale, df), B | Sigma, Y ~ MN(mean, omega, Sigma); sigma_mean = scale / (df - n - 1). mean/scale/omega: exact QR-based values (target). *_bvar: BVAR 1.0.5 (normal equations; BVAR:::bv_ml + the S_post formula of BVAR:::draw_post), less accurate on ill-conditioned levels data: see bvar_vs_exact (max |diff| / max |value|). forecast: quantiles of one-path-per-draw simulations from iid posterior draws, with batch-quantile MCSE.
